meta.title: A graph to read before you run it
meta.about: Nothing here is harmful, and everything here is worth noticing. Read it the way you would read a download.
needs: An image in your input folder. The graph names example.png: pick your own in the loader.

notes.1: Needs a file that the graph does not contain.
notes.2: Reaches the output below, so it runs.
notes.3: The path is built inside the output folder, and the server refuses one that leaves it.
notes.4: No output asks for this, so it stays idle. Dead nodes are worth asking about.
notes.5: Plain text sits in a graph like any other value, and it can say anything.
notes.6: Shows the text. Text does nothing until a node uses it.

inputs.value: text inside a graph is only text
